plain: Very hateful and shameful; deserving strong disgust.

example.quote: If this be the language or spirit which causes its suspension, this nefarious, abominable project will be again introduced the first favorable opportunity.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 13, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
